title: The Merchant???
move_pattern: Starts with Swipe. Then randomly selects from Swipe, Spew Coins, Throw Relic, or Enrage (with Enrage weighted 3x). After Throw Relic, can only select from Swipe, Spew Coins, or Throw Relic.
notes: The Merchant has two distinct behavioral phases. Initially, it uses all four moves with a preference for Enrage (weighted 3x compared to other moves in the random selection). Once it uses Throw Relic, it enters a more focused attack pattern, limiting itself to Swipe, Spew Coins, and Throw Relic (excluding Enrage until the next Throw Relic triggers). This phase transition allows it to chain more damage and Frail application.
